user.title: Connect FamilyOS
user.description: In FamilyOS, open Settings, You, Connected apps (as an admin) and add an app. Give it a role and choose whether its changes happen at once or wait for approval, then copy the key. It is shown once.

data_description.url: The address of your FamilyOS, for example {local_example} or {remote_example}.
data_description.api_key: The app key from FamilyOS. It starts with famos_.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to FamilyOS again
reauth_confirm.description: FamilyOS no longer accepts the key for {url}. Add a new key to the app in FamilyOS (or a new app) and enter it here.

data_description.api_key: The new app key from FamilyOS.

reconfigure.title: Change the FamilyOS key
reconfigure.description: Enter the address of this FamilyOS and a new key for the app (add the key in FamilyOS first, then revoke the old one). Currently connected to {url}.

data_description.url: The address of your FamilyOS, for example {local_example} or {remote_example}.
data_description.api_key: The new app key from FamilyOS.

error.unsupported: This address answers, but it is not a FamilyOS that has the public API (version 0.3 or newer is needed).

abort.wrong_family: This key belongs to a different FamilyOS (another address). To connect that one, add it as a new integration.

init.title: FamilyOS options
init.description: Act for: the id of a family member (it starts with member_) that this app may act for. When you set it, every change is made as that person, and what they and the app's role both allow applies; a supervised person's changes wait for approval. Leave it empty and the app's own role applies.

data_description.scan_interval: Changes made in FamilyOS show in Home Assistant within this time. Asking is cheap: FamilyOS only answers with what changed.
data_description.act_for: The member id is shown in FamilyOS where the app's "May act for" list is edited.

error.act_for_refused: FamilyOS refused this person. The app must be allowed to act for them (Settings, You, Connected apps).

auth_failed.message: FamilyOS no longer accepts the key. Enter a new one in the integration settings.

chore_not_due.message: "{chore}" has no due date to complete.

chore_needs_person.message: An app is nobody, so say who did the chore (done_by), or set "Act for" in the integration options.

no_such_entry.message: There is no FamilyOS connection to use. Add the integration first.

several_entries.message: More than one FamilyOS is connected. Choose which one with config_entry_id.

repeat_unsupported.message: This repeat rule cannot be used here. FamilyOS repeats daily, weekly (on chosen days) or monthly, with an interval and an end date.

repeat_change_unsupported.message: Changing how an event repeats is not supported from Home Assistant. Change it in FamilyOS.

following_unsupported.message: Changing or deleting "this and following" is not supported from Home Assistant. Choose this event only, or all events.

feature_unavailable.message: FamilyOS does not offer this to the app: it is switched off or the app's role may not use it.

nothing_to_change.message: Say what to change: text, paper or ends_on.

paused.message: This app is paused in FamilyOS. Its changes will work again after it is resumed there; nothing needs to be done in Home Assistant.
